findings.evidenceJa: 警策を振り下ろす
findings.governingReading: swings the keisaku down
findings.explanation: The specific Reinforced temple implement is again generalized to a weapon.

findings.highlight: I swing my weapon down onto his head
findings.evidenceJa: 脳天から股下、縦一文字に叩き下ろした一撃
findings.governingReading: a full-force vertical strike driven in a straight line from crown to below the crotch
findings.explanation: The complete top-to-bottom path and severity of Shirou’s blow disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 壁に張り付いていた虫たち
findings.governingReading: the insects that had been clinging to the wall
findings.explanation: The creatures’ surface attachment is reduced to proximity.

findings.evidenceJa: アサシンのサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: the Assassin-class Servant
findings.explanation: The class identification is rendered in malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: 悉く同じ剣によって防がれていた
findings.governingReading: all four were blocked by the very same blade
findings.explanation: The single-blade feat connecting all four simultaneous defenses disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: しくじりおったのか
findings.governingReading: did Assassin fail or botch it
findings.explanation: Zouken’s shocked question about an unspecified failure becomes a claim that Assassin was meant to kill Saber.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺を白い髑髏のサーヴァントから守るように現れた
findings.governingReading: appears before him as though shielding him from the white-skull Servant
findings.explanation: A visual arrangement suggesting protection becomes Rider’s certified purpose in coming.

findings.highlight: too quickly for mere human eyes to follow
findings.evidenceJa: 肉眼で追えるものではなかった
findings.governingReading: not something the naked eye could track
findings.explanation: A perceptual-speed statement becomes a species limitation.

findings.evidenceJa: お堂狭しと跳ね回る
findings.governingReading: bounds around as though the hall is too small to contain him
findings.explanation: The image of Assassin filling the confined hall with movement disappears.

findings.highlight: can neither be blocked nor avoided
findings.evidenceJa: 防ぐ事も躱す事も許されないだろう
findings.governingReading: would likely permit neither defense nor evasion
findings.explanation: Shirou’s prediction becomes an absolute tactical fact immediately before Rider disproves it.

findings.evidenceJa: 苛立ちを含んだ猛攻
findings.governingReading: a fierce barrage that seems tinged with irritation
findings.explanation: The emotional quality of Assassin’s offensive is rendered in visibly unnatural English.

findings.evidenceJa: 一匹の、巨大な蛇がいた
findings.governingReading: there was one enormous serpent
findings.explanation: The Rider-as-serpent reveal is rendered as an unidiomatic existential fragment.

findings.evidenceJa: 敵を威圧する迫力
findings.governingReading: an intimidating force or presence that overawes an enemy
findings.explanation: Rider’s overwhelming presence is mistranslated as coercive conduct.

findings.highlight: Rider jumps up to the ceiling, and Assassin jumps down to the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 天井へ飛ぶライダーの短剣と、地面に跳ぶアサシンの短剣
findings.governingReading: Rider’s dagger flies toward the ceiling as Assassin’s dagger leaps toward the ground
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns the weapons’ opposed trajectories to the combatants themselves, changing the choreography.

findings.highlight: Rider hurls Assassin through the air
findings.evidenceJa: あろうことか
findings.governingReading: to Shirou’s disbelief, Rider begins swinging Assassin with the chain
findings.explanation: The narrator’s disbelief and the onset of chain-driven swinging are reduced to a generic throw.

findings.highlight: smashed against every surface in the room
findings.evidenceJa: 壁という壁に激突し
findings.governingReading: slammed into wall after wall
findings.explanation: The impacts are broadened from walls to every surface.

findings.highlight: This isn’t on a level of being strong
findings.evidenceJa: 怪力とか乱暴とか、もうそういう次元の話じゃない
findings.governingReading: this has gone beyond categories such as brute strength or violence
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits violence from Shirou’s claim that ordinary categories no longer describe Rider’s handling of Assassin.

findings.evidenceJa: 鉄球
findings.governingReading: iron ball, read as Assassin
findings.explanation: The ruby identifying Assassin as Rider’s iron ball disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 体中の骨を砕かれた
findings.governingReading: with the bones throughout his entire body crushed
findings.explanation: The full-body extent and crushing force are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 山門から転がり落ちていった
findings.governingReading: rolls down and away from the mountain gate
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents stairs as the final route of Assassin’s fall.

findings.highlight: Servants aren’t so weak as to die from that
findings.evidenceJa: 消滅するほどサーヴァントはヤワではない
findings.governingReading: Servants are probably not so fragile that this would make one disappear
findings.explanation: Supernatural disappearance is replaced by ordinary death.

findings.highlight: The worms that were squirming in the corner
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの暴挙で隅に逃げていた虫たち
findings.governingReading: the insects that had fled into the corners from Rider’s violence
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes why the insects hid, changes hiding to squirming, and collapses multiple corners.
